data.content: Elsa Group is a leading company in the field of processing of granite, marble, quartz and onyx. It is the only one in the region capable of cutting and processing of all types of granite.

We have been selected to provide a variety of services, from full on campaigns to daily activity on the social media, producing a number of TV commercials and corporate materials promoting the biggest brand on the field.

Seeking to attract new customers and create a more modern brand identity, Elsa Group asked us to redesign and rebuild their website. We looked for opportunities to express the diversity of the brand and a design that would reinvigorate the brand and reinforce the company's position as the leader in the granite and marble market.
Check out the website here.
